title: Seismicity in volumetric support: b-value against hypocentre dimension
status: Specified and committed BEFORE any regional catalogue was obtained. The data hosts were not reachable from the registering environment; experiments/run_volumetric_b.py is ready to run where they are. The prediction was first committed in docs/resource-catalogue.md (commit e4bf526).
prior_exposure: The registrant knows: Aki (1981) proposed b = D/2; Hirata (1989) reported a negative correlation between b and the epicentre correlation dimension; high b-values are reported for some volcanic swarms. This test therefore defines the support dimension from hypocentres, measured independently of magnitudes, and predicts the relation, rather than relying on known swarm b-values.
question: When earthquakes in a cluster occupy a support of dimension D2 (from hypocentre correlation), does b follow the territory prediction b = D2/2, or the fractal-diffusive self-organized criticality prediction b = 1 independent of support?

H_territory.why: Territory rule: ruptures tile a support of dimension D2, so N(>L) ∝ L^-D2; with M0 ∝ L^3 and M ∝ (2/3) log10 M0, b = D2/2. A planar fault (D2 = 2) gives b = 1; a volume (D2 = 3) gives b = 1.5.

H_fdsoc.why: Fractal-diffusive self-organized criticality predicts energy exponent 5/3 in three dimensions, b = 1, independent of the hypocentre support.

data.source: A relocated regional catalogue with hypocentres and a cluster identifier, for example the Southern California relocated catalogue (Hauksson, Yang and Shearer 2012, updated) with clusters from a nearest-neighbour declustering (Zaliapin and Ben-Zion 2013), or published swarm lists. Record exactly which catalogue and cluster definition were used before computing b or D2.
data.input_format: CSV with columns x_km, y_km, z_km (or latitude, longitude, depth_km), mag, cluster.

estimator.clusters: Clusters with at least 200 events above their completeness magnitude.
estimator.b: Aki-Utsu maximum likelihood above Mc = maximum-curvature magnitude + 0.2, with bin correction for 0.1 rounding; standard error from 500 bootstrap resamples.
estimator.D2: Correlation dimension from the slope of log C(r) on log r over r between 3 and 30 times the median nearest-neighbour hypocentre distance, using hypocentres of events above Mc; standard error from 500 bootstrap resamples.
estimator.regression: Errors-in-variables (Deming) regression of b on D2 with the bootstrap variances; 95% interval for the slope by bootstrap over clusters.

decision_rule.support_H_territory: Slope interval contains 0.5 and excludes 0, and the intercept interval contains 0.
decision_rule.support_H_fdsoc: Slope interval contains 0 and excludes 0.5, and the mean b interval contains 1.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Otherwise, including fewer than 10 qualifying clusters or a D2 range narrower than 0.5.
